    groups = []
    for c in cols:
        if not groups or c > groups[-1][-1] + 1:
            groups.append([c])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(c)
    return groups


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    col_groups = _runs([c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h))])
    if len(col_groups) != 2:
        raise ValueError("expected two separated panels")

    panels = []
    for cols in col_groups:
        c0, c1 = cols[0], cols[-1] + 1
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for c in range(c0, c1))]
        r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows) + 1
        panels.append([[grid[r][c] != 0 for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)])

    width = max(len(p[0]) for p in panels)
    offsets = [(width - len(p[0])) // 2 for p in panels]
    height = max(map(len, panels))
    xor = []
    for r in range(height):
        line = []
        for c in range(width):
            vals = []
            for p, off in zip(panels, offsets):
                pc = c - off
                vals.append(bool(p[r][pc]) if r < len(p) and 0 <= pc < len(p[0]) else False)
            line.append(vals[0] != vals[1])
        xor.append(line)

    # The informative mismatch is the longest uninterrupted run of rows;
    # isolated, separated edge irregularities are incidental framing.

    runs = []
    i = 0

            i += 1
            continue
        j = i + 1
        while j < height and active[j]:
            j += 1
        runs.append((j - i, i, j))
        i = j
    if not runs:
